king_aldous.name: King Aldous
king_aldous.description: An old king in a heavy red mantle, who has stopped looking at the people he speaks to.

dialog.greeting: Captain. You are late.

captain_kessa.name: Captain Kessa
captain_kessa.description: A tall woman in a horned helm, your oldest friend in the fleet.

dialog.greeting: There you are. I heard the king sent for you.

rosalind.name: Rosalind
rosalind.description: A healer in white, sleeves rolled, a basin of clean water at her elbow.

dialog.greeting: You look tired. Sit, and let me look at you.

quartermaster.name: quartermaster
quartermaster.description: A gruff man behind a counter stacked with fleet stores.

dialog.greeting: Fleet stores. Nothing fancy.

mayor_of_hazevale.name: mayor of Hazevale
mayor_of_hazevale.description: A soft-spoken man in a village chain of office.

dialog.greeting: Travellers are rare, these days.

ryn.name: Ryn
ryn.description: A small girl in green, clutching a wooden flute, with eyes much older than the rest of her.

dialog.greeting: Please... go away.

innkeeper.name: innkeeper
innkeeper.description: A stout woman with a ring of keys and a lantern she never seems to put down.

dialog.greeting: Fog keeps the guests away. There is always a bed.

chancellor.name: chancellor
chancellor.description: A gaunt man in grey silks at the king's elbow, smiling as if he had been taught how.

dialog.greeting: The king has many burdens. I carry the smaller ones.

castle_guard.name: castle guard
castle_guard.description: A guard of the Red Fleet in polished plate, halberd grounded, eyes fixed on nothing.

dialog.greeting: Move along, captain. The king's business is not ours to discuss.

elder_of_ilmara.name: elder of Ilmara
elder_of_ilmara.description: An old man in pale robes, one hand flat on the altar as if he were steadying it, or himself.

dialog.greeting: Take it, then.

ilmaran_acolyte.name: Ilmaran acolyte
ilmaran_acolyte.description: A young mystic in pale robes, with nothing in their hands but a little light.

dialog.greeting: Please. Please, do not.

red_fleet_soldier.name: Red Fleet soldier
red_fleet_soldier.description: A soldier of the Red Fleet in dark plate, helm under one arm, looking at something a long way off.

dialog.greeting: Orders are orders, captain. That is what we keep telling each other.

red_fleet_raider.name: Red Fleet soldier
red_fleet_raider.description: A soldier of the Red Fleet in dark plate, helm under one arm, looking at something a long way off.

dialog.greeting: Orders are orders, captain. That is what we keep telling each other.

desert_innkeeper.name: innkeeper
desert_innkeeper.description: A stout woman with a ring of keys and a lantern she never seems to put down.

dialog.greeting: Welcome out of the sun. There is always a bed.

ryn_young.name: Ryn
ryn_young.description: A small girl in green, a wooden flute at her belt, with eyes much older than the rest of her.

dialog.greeting: Where do we go now?

water_carrier.name: water carrier
water_carrier.description: A lean man with two jars on a yoke, a path worn smooth between his bare feet.

dialog.greeting: Fresh from the well, and cold as a rumour. A copper for a cup, or a kind word for nothing.

spice_seller.name: spice seller
spice_seller.description: A round woman behind a table of little heaps, every colour of the desert.

dialog.greeting: Cumin, saffron, dried limes. Take a sniff, take a sniff; the sniff is free.

date_picker.name: old date picker
date_picker.description: A wiry old man with a sling of rope round his waist and a face like a dried date.

dialog.greeting: Mind the palms, traveller. They drop things, and they never apologise.

lizard_child.name: village child
lizard_child.description: A barefoot child with a jar in one hand and sand to the elbows.

dialog.greeting: Have you seen a lizard? A blue tail? Very fast? He is mine, and he is lost.

potter_ilse.name: Ilse the potter
potter_ilse.description: A broad woman with clay-grey forearms and a smear on her cheek.

dialog.greeting: Clay from the dry wash. It fires hot and it breaks easy, like most things worth having.

widow_tamsin.name: Widow Tamsin
widow_tamsin.description: A small, upright old woman in black, a bowl of dates in her lap.

dialog.greeting: I do not get many visitors. Sit, sit. Take a date. Everyone talks about the fever these days, and nobody about the dates.

pell_trader.name: Pell the trader
pell_trader.description: A thin man in a spotless apron, with an abacus he does not need.

dialog.greeting: Potions, salves, the odd thing a traveller forgot. Buy what you like; I can always find more.

brannoch_smith.name: Brannoch the smith
brannoch_smith.description: A man built like his own anvil, with a leather apron scorched in a dozen places.

dialog.greeting: Armour for the road, and a staff or two. Try the cap on; it fits most heads.

orrin.name: Orrin
orrin.description: An old man with a stoop and a lantern jaw, his sleeves rolled to the elbow and a wet cloth in his hand.

dialog.greeting: She sleeps. The fever breaks in the mornings and comes back by noon. Sit if you like; there is not much else to do.

maren.name: Maren
maren.description: An old woman with iron-grey hair under a scarf, a bowl of water at her knee.

dialog.greeting: Hush, now. She has only just gone off. Orrin will tell you what there is to tell.

rosalind_sick.name: Rosalind
rosalind_sick.description: A woman in a borrowed nightdress, her face grey and shining with fever, her hair stuck to her temples. You would know the line of her anywhere.

dialog.greeting: ...is that you?
